checks.name: public application submission target is available

checks.required: Published public page and open public job

checks.name: controlled application is still missing before submission

approval channel is recorded for execution or deferred in dry-run
approval timestamp is ISO-like for execution or deferred in dry-run
controlled public application submission approval is recorded for execution or deferred in dry-run
live application notification email acknowledgement is recorded for execution or deferred in dry-run
controlled applicant mailbox approval is recorded for execution or deferred in dry-run
stable idempotency submission ID is recorded for execution or deferred in dry-run

checks.name: current legal consent policy version is available
raw controlled applicant email is available only after approval gates pass
